Menacing.Name: Menacing
Menacing.SelectToken: Select a token you own to toggle Menacing.
Menacing.ToggleError: Could not toggle Menacing. See the console for details.

YourTurn.EnabledHint: Play a Persona-style cut-in on the map whenever the combat turn changes.
YourTurn.ScaleHint: Size of the cut-in, from half size to one and a half. 1 is the default.
YourTurn.PortraitWidthHint: World-wide exact display width for every turn portrait at Your Turn Scale 1 (100–1000 px; default 400). Small images enlarge and large images shrink without stretching. Height follows the image's proportions; tall art or large values can extend beyond the backdrop. No hidden fit-down cap. Applies to the next turn or preview; each user's overall scale still applies.
YourTurn.HoldHint: Seconds the cut-in stays fully visible before it leaves.
